name: skill-repo-deployed-drift-check
tags: skills drift deployed repo copy source of truth diff before editing skill.md claude skills directory sync dev main branch behind, task:628fcd72
body:
Before editing any skill.md, three copies can disagree — diff all of them: the dev worktree copy (~/workspace/claude-hooks-dev/skills/...), the main worktree copy (~/workspace/claude-hooks/skills/...), and the deployed copy (~/.claude/skills/...).

Why: task:628fcd72 found dev's task-grooming copy two versions stale. First diagnosis blamed uncommitted deployed-only edits, but the truth was main already had the rewrite committed (90e421b) while the dev branch was behind — editing dev's stale copy caused a merge conflict at /deploy --ship. Skill commits that land on main without flowing back to dev create this silently.

How to apply: run `diff` dev-vs-deployed AND `git -C ~/workspace/claude-hooks log --oneline -3 main -- skills/<name>/skill.md` before editing; if dev is behind, sync/merge first, then edit on top. Expect trivial frontmatter-date conflicts at ship time otherwise.
